text: Hello everyone, my parents would like to come visit us this summer (I’m the non-Israeli spouse). The last time they visited, we were told that they would need a letter of invitation from us that is approved by Misrad Hapnim. We’re not sure how this process works. Do we need to schedule an appointment with Misrad Hapnim? Is there an application process involved, similar to applying for a visa? Or is it a matter of just going to Misrad Hapnim and asking for it? Thank you!
